title: cadis belongs on your radar
description:
Growth-Circle/cadis is the kind of repo that can quietly upgrade a developer workflow. Rust-first, local-first multi-agent runtime with a desktop HUD, policy-gated tools, voice, and worktree-isolated coding agents. It has about 45 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/Growth-Circle/cadis
